ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels vs 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and the median notch. Two distinct circular dark focal spots are present: one mid-span on the left lobe and one lower-mid-span on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetric V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks (3-8 pixels) observed along the trailing edges, becoming most irregular at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, posteriorly curved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two discrete, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters (roughly 12-15 pixels in diameter) located within the white interior fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed; a dense cluster of diagonal and vertical lines on the right lobe and minor vertical disruptions on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks on the right ventral lobe and significant jagged irregularities along the trailing edge consistent with prior tissue damage.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive symmetrical 'eye-like' dark pigmentation spots situated within the primary white zones of each fluke lobe.
